dict.string: NutriLift India reads steps, active energy, workouts, and body mass from Apple Health to show daily activity and optional weight trends. All data stays on your device.
NutriLift India may write body mass you log in the app to Apple Health if you choose. Nothing is uploaded to NutriLift servers.
Take a meal photo for on-device calorie and macro estimates using Apple Foundation Models. Photos stay on your device and are not uploaded.
Choose a meal photo for on-device nutrition estimates. Photos stay on your device and are not uploaded.
